svg.aria-label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY TAVILY_API_KEY: The model and the search. LANGSMITH_TRACING LANGSMITH_API_KEY LANGSMITH_PROJECT LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT: LangSmith. EU accounts must set the EU endpoint; a wrong region means 403 on /runs/multipart uploads. LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY LANGFUSE_HOST: Langfuse. RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RETRIES RATE_LIMIT_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS RATE_LIMIT_BASE_SLEEP_SECONDS: The 429 guardrail in debate/rate_limit.py. It honours the retry-after header, backs off exponentially otherwise, and stacks on the Anthropic SDK's own retries (default 2 per call): a long 429 storm costs up to 3 x (RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RETRIES + 1) requests
